title: Member Servicing Timelines: Lender-Placed Coverage, Payoff Statements and Lien Release (Rural Home Loans)
content:
Timelines and the lender-placed premium rate that apply to every Rural Home Loans product.

## Items

- **Lender-placed notice days** — calendar days from the first notice of missing homeowner's insurance before coverage is lender-placed (two notices, the second at least 15 days before placement).
- **Lender-placed premium** — annual premium of lender-placed homeowner's coverage, percent of the principal balance at placement.
- **Payoff statement validity** — calendar days a payoff statement remains good, the statement date being day 0.
- **Lien release days** — calendar days after payoff by which the deed of reconveyance is sent for recording.

## Table

| Product | Lender-placed notice days | Lender-placed premium (annual percent) | Payoff statement validity (days) | Lien release days |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Country Home 15-Year Fixed | 45 | 1.85 | 30 | 30 |
| Country Home 20-Year Fixed | 45 | 1.85 | 30 | 30 |
| Country Home 30-Year Fixed | 45 | 1.85 | 30 | 30 |
| Country Home 5/6 Adjustable | 45 | 1.85 | 30 | 30 |
| Country Home 7/6 Adjustable | 45 | 1.85 | 30 | 30 |
| Country Home Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | 45 | 1.85 | 30 | 30 |

## Counting illustration (hypothetical)

A payoff statement dated on a given day is day 0; it remains good through day 30, the thirtieth calendar day after its date, and is no longer good on day 31.
